info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Dealer Desk Information API
info.description: The Dealer Desk Information API provides access to comprehensive data regarding wholesale trading activities within the dealer desk environment. This endpoint is designed to facilitate brokers, traders, and financial analysts in retrieving essential information related to trading positions, market insights, and dealer operations. By leveraging this API, users can enhance decision-making processes and streamline trading activities. Typical use cases include analyzing trading performance and monitoring market trends to make informed buy or sell decisions.

get.summary: Retrieve dealer desk information for wholesale trading.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access detailed information about the dealer desk within the wholesale trading context. It provides insights into dealer activities and performance, helping stakeholders make informed decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve dealer desk information related to wholesale trading operations. Ensure that the request conforms to the specific schema to get accurate results.

200.description: Request completed successfully with the desired data.

GetDealerDeskDataRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for the operations GET request in the dealer desk context of wholesale trading.

items.description: A list of trading items associated with the dealer desk operations.

sort.description: The sorting criteria applied to the trading items.

GetDealerDeskDataResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operation on the dealer desk in wholesale trading.

tradingBookId.description: The unique identifier for the trading book.

instrumentId.description: The unique identifier for the financial instrument involved in the trading.

side.description: The side of the trade (buy or sell).

quantity.description: The number of units involved in the trading.

recordStatus.description: The status of the trading record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the trading item was last updated.

TradingItem.description: Represents a trading item for the dealer desk operations.

value.description: The limit price for the trading transaction.

currency.description: The currency in which the limit price is denominated.

LimitPrice.description: Defines the limit price details of a trading item.

page.description: The current page number of the paginated response.

pageSize.description: The number of items displayed per page.

totalItems.description: The total number of trading items available.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to trace the request across multiple systems.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Geographic region where the processing took place.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for authentication. Clients must include a valid Bearer token in the authorization header to access secured endpoints.
